question: Should `skills.securityVerdicts` accept sanitized requests for up to 25 explicit default-ClawHub slug/version pairs under `operator.read` to support pre-install review?
rationale: The code appears bounded and does not bypass admin-gated installation, but changing what read-scoped clients may cause the Gateway to fetch is an intentional authorization and product-boundary choice.

options.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
options.body: Retain the default-registry-only sanitized request mode after conflict resolution and complete exact-head installation proof.

options.title: Use Server-Owned Review
options.body: Replace explicit client-selected items with a narrower Gateway install-review operation or server-issued review token.

options.title: Defer Android Installs
options.body: Keep Android skill settings read-only until maintainers sponsor the mobile installation workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
recommendation.body: Retain the default-registry-only sanitized request mode after conflict resolution and complete exact-head installation proof.
